method: No new measurements. HTTP duration is exact retained client latency; recorded_ns follows file writes and semantic validation. Same-worker previous record <= next start; the last warmup record bounds the first pressure start; timestamps bound true start/end. Intersections of guaranteed cores are lower bounds; envelope intersections are upper bounds. No requests excluded; wall-clock timestamps and monotonic durations are combined assuming no clock step during each request. No inference of simultaneous server CPU execution.
